rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Gives AI agents the ability to scan skills, plugins, and MCP configurations for security threats before installation. Built on the Aguara open-source scanner with 160+ rules across 15 threat categories, three analysis engines (pattern, NLP, toxic-flow), and zero network access. Provides tools for content scanning, MCP config analysis, rule browsing, and local MCP server discovery.
